answer: Sustained Jitter Chain: each agent appends hash links embedding live NIC clock-skew, so dune-flat emulators fail the per-microsecond variance test. Validators reject links outside the vertex band (±2 ns) set by the first 200 links; a break voids all downstream reputation. Cloning one NIC into N agents costs N physical NICs plus 40 Gbps hash-churn, traceable to a single canyon rack port.
